qa.question: Can an email draft really send later?
qa.answer: Yes, if it was scheduled, sent through an authorized app or API, or affected by user action, sync, or account behavior. That does not mean it acted supernaturally.

qa.question: Is Undo Send the same as recalling an email?
qa.answer: No. In many systems, Undo Send delays sending briefly. Once the delay expires, the message may be out of your control.

qa.question: Why might a sent email still appear in Drafts?
qa.answer: Some clients or sync states can leave confusing draft copies. A draft copy does not always mean the message was never sent.

qa.question: Could connected apps send drafts?
qa.answer: Authorized apps or APIs can interact with drafts depending on permissions. Account activity and connected apps should be checked if something seems wrong.

qa.question: Why does this motif feel scary?
qa.answer: It makes private, unfinished language seem to escape into public communication before the sender feels ready.
